blockText: Your friendship and requests between you will end, and new requests from this person will stop coming. They won't be told.
nickText: A nickname on this server instead of “{{name}}”. Empty means none.
rolesText: You can give and take only roles below your highest.
banText: The member will leave the server and can't come back until unbanned.
kickText: The member will leave the server but can come back with an invite.
serverMicOn: Turn on microphone on the server
serverMicOff: Turn off microphone on the server
serverSoundOn: Turn on sound on the server
serverSoundOff: Turn off sound on the server
